name: Pavel Andrusca
event: UFC Fight Night: Adesanya vs. Magomedov
summary: An unbeaten Moldovan (9-0, age 24) who beat Nathaniel Wood by decision on short notice in his UFC debut in September, up at featherweight; he returns to bantamweight here.
